comments.author: h1alexbel
comments.body:
@volodya-lombrozo 

Here is what happens on `Java 8` with `qulice-maven-plugin=0.23.0`:
```text
java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: com/puppycrawl/tools/checkstyle/api/CheckstyleException has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime (class file version 55.0), this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes class file versions up to 52.0
```
This means a version mismatch: runtime is of version `52.0=Java1.8`, while class was compiled by the version of `55 =Java 11`. Check [this answer on Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/a/47457251/19147117). This is because [qulice](https://github.com/yegor256/qulice) [didn't support Java 1.8](https://github.com/yegor256/qulice/issues/1292#issuecomment-2160169868). Can we get rid of Java 1.8 here too, and build our code on Java 11+?
